name: Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome
tagline: Shinjuku in 3 minutes and Shibuya in 13 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Shibuya City, served by Toei Oedo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 27 minutes to Otemachi, 3 minutes to Shinjuku, 13 minutes to Shibuya and 34 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 28 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 15.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 28 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 25.4 m to 40.6 m, a difference of 15.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: はんこ屋さん21 西新宿店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 雙立会雙立病院, about 6 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 輝生会初台リハビリテーション病院, about 7 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Oedo Line.
congestion: Toei Oedo Line runs at 147% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥260,000 to ¥270,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. What holds the figure down: only one line, the {line}, serving the station. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome, but Tochomae is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome. It is served by the same lines as Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome. To Roppongi, for instance, Tochomae takes 20 minutes longer. A one-room flat costs about ¥21,000 more at Tochomae. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, Tochomae comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Nakano-Sakaue is ahead on the number of lines and the number of medical facilities, but Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome is ahead on how easy the shopping is and quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome. Nakano-Sakaue also has the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, which Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome does not. With more lines, Nakano-Sakaue is the better connected of the two. To Otemachi, for instance, Nakano-Sakaue is 3 minutes quicker. A one-room flat also costs about ¥7,000 less at Nakano-Sakaue. On quiet, though, Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome comes out ahead.

noiseSources: The 首都高速中央環状線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
淀橋渋谷本町線 (1 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 8 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Oedo Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
